entities.summary: Alexander George Clare is a British singer and songwriter based in London, UK. His debut album, The Lateness of the Hour, was released in the UK on 8 July 2011 on Island Records and was produced by Mike Spencer and Major Lazer. Alex Clare was a composers & musicians from Southwark (b. 1985-09-14, Southwark). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
